name: memories
source:
It was spring, when the coldness begins to subside.

The protagonist Higuchi Yuumi's parents get transferred overseas due to work. For the sake of her studies and her future, they decide that it's best for Yumi to stay in Japan alone. With her best interests in mind, her parents arrange for Yumi to attend Saint Claus Academy. Apparently, they decided on Saint Claus due to its high number of students from respectable families, its firm administrative policies and how it also has a joint university.

Yumi struggles to get used to being in a new town, living on her own and her new school life. Though she's apprehensive about the many things she has to do for the first time, Yumi makes good friends and is able to enjoy life with a positive outlook.

She meets various boys. Feelings of love begin to faintly grow in her heart. As she grows closer to them, she starts to see the various problems the boys were dealing with. Seeing their struggles inspires Yumi to seriously think about her own future, rather than aimlessly living day-by-day.

As Yumi gradually matures through overcoming the hurdles of friendship and love, what awaits her in the end...?

[Translation of story summary from [URL=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009779.html/]DL Site[/url].]
translation:
那是寒意开始消退的春天。

主人公樋口优美的父母因工作调往海外。为了她的学业与未来，他们认为让优美独自留在日本才是最佳选择。父母处处为她着想，安排她进入圣克劳斯学园就读。据说，他们选择这里，是因为学校拥有众多出身良好家庭的学生、严格稳健的管理方针，以及附属大学。

优美努力适应陌生的城镇、独居生活和全新的校园。尽管对许多初次尝试的事情心怀不安，她还是结交到好朋友，并以积极的态度享受生活。

她邂逅了形形色色的男孩，朦胧的爱意开始在心中萌芽。随着彼此逐渐亲近，她也看见男孩们各自面对的烦恼。他们的挣扎促使优美认真思考自己的未来，而不再浑浑噩噩地过完每一天。

优美跨越友情与爱情的重重难关，一点点成长，最终等待她的会是什么…？

[故事简介翻译自[URL=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009779.html/]DL Site[/url]。]
